description.full:
Adventure Tours UK is a B Corp-certified adventure holiday company based in Llanarmon-yn-Ial in the Clwydian Range and Dee Valley AONB, Denbighshire, North Wales. Founded by husband-and-wife team Claire and Jim Copeman, the company specialises in carefully crafted active holidays that connect people with nature and local communities through authentic experiences in the UK's wild spaces.

The company offers a broad range of guided and self-directed adventures: small group tours (4–14 days), self-guided hiking and cycling holidays, tailor-made itineraries for individuals, couples, families, and corporate groups, and specialist programmes including trail running breaks, wild wellness retreats, and women-only leadership camps. Activities include hiking, mountain biking, trail running, canyoning, gorge walking, stand-up paddleboarding, packrafting, riverbugging, and rib rides.

North Wales — including Snowdonia, the Clwydian Range, and the Dee Valley — is at the heart of their offering, but the company also operates throughout South Wales and across Scotland and other UK regions. They work with local guides and accommodation providers, and their woodland planting project at Ty'n-y-Pistyll supports their Net Zero by 2030 commitment.

The company holds B Corp certification (awarded March 2023, impact score 80.7), is a member of ABTOT and the Adventure Travel Trade Association (ATTA), a signatory of the Glasgow Declaration on Climate Action in Tourism, a Visit Wales partner, and holds Denbighshire Tourism Ambassador and Good to Go Wales status.
